name: Supersaturation\footnote{The term `supersaturation', from extremal combinatorics, describes when we wish to ``determine the minimum number of copies of a particular substructure in a combinatorial object of prescribed size'' . For us, the substructure is defined by a Diophantine equation.} in squares minus one
